description: D26 fix (rc.5): the link browser's filter field lays its text out inside the box the text is clipped to, for the placeholder and for a descender-heavy query, in light and dark, at the D26 text-field height (24 pt; a medium Input is 26 pt, so a lost Styled::h shows here even though `content` is derived from the code's own inset)
notes: view.layout.filter (views/layout.rs Layout::text_field, automation builds): `field` is the field's laid-out bounds; `content` is that box less the field's border and vertical padding (theming::text_field_inset_y), the box gpui-component clips a single-line Input's text to (its InputState container is overflow_x_hidden, and gpui-pre 0.3.7's overflow_mask then clips y to the container too); `text` is the line box the InputState laid out this frame (InputState::input_bounds, one line height tall), which the glyphs, descenders included, are drawn in; `centre_offset` is |text centre − field centre|.

Fails on 713e9cd (rc.4): theming::text_field's .h(CONTROL_H) is gpui-component Input's multi-line-only height, so the field stays a medium Input (26 pt, 8 pt padding, 1 pt border): an 8 pt clip box for a 16 pt line, and the text loses its top and bottom (descenders) to the clip.
Screenshots are kept for review (README `screenshot`); the layout steps are the check.
